definitions.gloss: standing room; standing section; standing-room-only area
definitions.explanation: A section in a theater, concert venue, or stadium where audience members stand rather than sit. Often the cheapest ticket option.

examples.japanese: ⟦{座席|ざせき}→座席：02832_zaseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れ→売り切れ：09556_urikire⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{見席|みせき}なら⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The seated tickets are sold out, but there's still standing room available.

examples.japanese: {立|た}ち{見席|みせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: Standing room tickets are cheap, but standing for a long time is tiring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{立|た}ち{見席|みせき}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{満員|まんいん}→満員：07584_manin⟧だった。
examples.english: It was such a popular performance that even the standing section was packed.

notes:
A designated area in a venue where the audience stands rather than sits. Typically the cheapest ticket option.

FORMS:
⟦{立|た}ち{見|み}→立ち見：08286_tachimi⟧ (standing viewing) + ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (seat/section). The shorter form ⟦{立|た}ち{見|み}→立ち見：08286_tachimi⟧ is also commonly used with the same meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立|た}ち{見席|みせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧: standing room ticket
- {立|た}ち{見席|みせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{観|み}る→観る：22793_miru⟧: to watch from the standing section
- {立|た}ち{見席|みせき}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{満員|まんいん}→満員：07584_manin⟧: standing room is full too

CULTURAL NOTE:
In sumo, {立|た}ち{見席|みせき} tickets are a well-known feature of sold-out tournaments, sold on the day at low prices. At live concerts, standing areas are often called スタンディング.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{指定席|していせき}→指定席：07046_shiteiseki⟧: reserved seat
- ⟦{自由席|じゆうせき}→自由席：07047_jiyuuseki⟧: unreserved seat
